player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''deadbody''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in March 2001.
description: This is an ISB Imp. Decree deck with lots o' walkers to combat fallen portal
cards: posted: Tempest scout 6 (gotta love that reacting deploy for 1)
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Crap 6': ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents (posted 'ISB/other side'), Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order (posted 'IAO'), Imperial Decree and Coruscant: Imperial Square; all count toward the 60. Several Effects start, none named as the starting Effect.

Posted 'Hoth db' and 'Yavin db' dested the Dark Hoth: Echo Docking Bay and Yavin 4: Docking Bay; 'Corescant db' dested Coruscant: Docking Bay (the Special Edition Dark site; the Coruscant-set printing came later).
Posted 'Generic DB' (an unnamed generic docking bay) is kept as written, as in 15617.
Posted '5x random ISB agents (any suggestions?)' names no cards and is kept as written (5 cards, counted).
Posted '2x Vader (choke is personal choice)' dested Darth Vader (Premiere); the poster leaves Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith (the choke Vader) as an option.

Posted 'Tarkin' dested Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Veers' dested General Veers (the walker pilot; the deck runs Blizzard 1 and walkers), not the Introductory Two-Player Veers; 'Lt. Pol' dested Lt. Pol Treidum; 'DS 61 2/3/4' dested DS-61-2, DS-61-3 and DS-61-4; 'Thrawn' dested Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'Chimera' dested Chimaera.

Posted 'Boba in pimp mobile' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Bossk in Grocery getter' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Zuckuss in @#$% Hunter' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Tw'Lek' dested Twi'lek Advisor.
Secret Plans is the 2001 Effect (Special Edition), not a Defensive Shield.
The list totals 60 as posted (6 starting, 5 locations, 21 characters, 10 starships/vehicles, 18 effects/interrupts).

The strategy calls this a variation of the poster's earlier 'Bring Him Before Me' deck. Would-like-to-adds (Reactor Terminal, another Imperial Command, SA Protection, grabbers, Nevar Yalnal) are not in the list.
